question: Ajay invests a certain sum of money on simple interest at 8% p.a. for 15 years. If the interest earned by him is Rs. 58,410, then find the sum invested by him.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total interest percentage = Rate × Time = 8% × 15 = 120%

Interest earned (120%) = 58,410

Sum invested (100%) = (58,410 ÷ 120) × 100

Sum = 486.75 × 100 = 48,675

**∴ Answer = 48,675**
